 Order

An application in I.A.No.2/2023 for recalling the order dated 13.10.2023 stating that in the memo for withdrawal, by inadvertently, liberty was not sought for to file a petition afresh on the same cause of action, since the pleadings were not effective.

2. Considering the reasons assigned in the affidavit accompanying application, the order dated 13.10.2023 is hereby recalled and the petition is accordingly dismissed as withdrawn reserving liberty to the petitioner to file a petition afresh on the same cause of action.
